name: axon-vendored-accordion
description: Vendored, detached copy of a-Fig/Accordion (MIT). This wrapper is Axon's, not upstream's: it exists so the pi-packages convention (one directory under pi-packages/ whose package.json carries the pi manifest) holds for a repo whose own package root is extension/. Every upstream file below it is byte-identical to the vendored revision. It also carries the test runner: the upstream suite is written for vitest, which Bun's vi shim does not fully implement, so `bun run test` here runs the byte-identical tests under the runner they were written for.
